project_title: The Barber's Ledger — Double-Entry Bookkeeping & POS for Barbershops
archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO x ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY APOTHECARY
theme: Dark-First Precision (Deep Obsidian Slate #0D0F12 with Rich Brass/Copper Accents #D97706 and High-Contrast Ledger Emerald/Crimson)

typography.pairing_philosophy: Precision Financial Modernism with Craftsman Weight. Headings use Outfit (bold, warm geometric display sans with subtle chiseled corners), body uses DM Sans for crisp legibility, and numbers/financial tables use JetBrains Mono for exact tabular alignment and zero-ambiguity figures.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Mode B High-Density Financial Bento & Tactical Command Center

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-[#181C24] border border-[#262C38] rounded-xl shadow-lg backdrop-blur-md hover:border-[#374151] transition-colors duration-200
visual_enhancers.badge_debit: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/20
visual_enhancers.badge_credit: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-mono font-medium bg-rose-500/10 text-rose-400 border border-rose-500/20
visual_enhancers.badge_balanced: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-medium bg-emerald-950 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-800
visual_enhancers.badge_locked: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/20

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure every financial table uses 'font-mono tabular-nums' for currency and account numbers so columns line up perfectly.
Enforce double-entry validation on Journal Entries: Total Debits MUST EQUAL Total Credits before 'Post' is enabled. Highlight balance status in real-time.
Role Switching UI: Include a prominent header selector (Owner/Admin, Accountant, Bookkeeper, Barber/Staff) so test agents and users can seamlessly preview permissions.
Every table, card, button, and input MUST have the explicit data-testid values listed above.
Use Lucide icons for bookkeeping & barber actions: Scissors, Receipt, Scale, Lock, ShieldCheck, DollarSign, Wallet, ArrowUpRight, ArrowDownLeft, FileText, RefreshCw.
Sonner toasts must trigger for posting journal entries, closing fiscal periods, completing POS sales, and performing daily cash close.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow high contrast accessibility in dark mode. Never use pure black #000000; use #0B0D10 and #12151B surface layers. Add data-testid to all interactive components. Ensure fast smooth interaction feedback.
